definitionZh: :用户无效的 CSS 伪类代表任何已验证的形式元素,其值根据其验证限制无效,在用户与之互动后.
sourceDefinition: The :user-invalid CSS pseudo-class represents any validated form element whose value isn't valid based on their validation constraints, after the user has interacted with it.
